retrievalProfile.description: A high-glamour composition featuring two subjects posed on dark volcanic rocks above a glowing lava field with futuristic italicized typography.
excludeWhen: minimalist or cold color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: Two women in high-fashion attire posed dynamically on jagged, dark grey rocks. Below them, a bed of glowing orange and yellow embers creates a strong bottom-up light source. The overall atmosphere is dramatic, warm, and stylized with a late 90s/early 2000s aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects positioned in the upper two-thirds of the frame
Glowing lava field acting as a high-contrast base
Warm rim lighting on subjects from the bottom-up glow
Large-scale typography overlaid across the mid-section
coreInvariants: High-contrast orange and black color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-body subjects occupying the center and upper-left/right quadrants, scaled to dominate the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, glowing orange lava field at the bottom of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the glowing lava, move up to the large central text, and then to the two subjects' faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with rock textures and subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and earthy browns of the rocks.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and yellow of the glowing lava.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and metallic jewelry.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the lava field contrasted with low-value, dark shadows in the rock crevices.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Italicized sans-serif with geometric, slightly squared curves.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with a strong rightward slant
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a simplified, open descender

composition.relationshipToImage: floating in front of the mid-ground

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact italicized sans-serif for the main title paired with a delicate, spaced-out serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and slant.
Appropriate for the high-contrast, elegant subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a scene with two women in glamorous outfits posed on dark, jagged volcanic rocks. The ground below them should be a glowing field of orange and yellow lava, casting a warm upward light on the rocks and subjects.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, italicized sans-serif text across the center of the image with a slight white-to-grey gradient. Add a smaller, wide-tracked serif subtitle in all caps at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the lava glow reflected on the subjects?
Is the main text italicized and centered?
Are the rocks dark and textured?
Is the color palette dominated by orange and charcoal?

mustRedesign: Ensure faces are unique and not copies of specific celebrities
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting direction from the lava.
Verify text legibility against the busy rock background.
Ensure the italicized font maintains a modern/futuristic feel.
Confirm the subjects' skin tones are influenced by the orange glow.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Volcanic/Lava Environment] + [High-Fashion Duo Pose] + [Futuristic Italic Typography] + [Warm Under-lighting].
